title: PCSO Lotto Results: Lone Lotto 6/42 winner gets P26.9M in November 19, 2026 draw
summary: A Lotto 6/42 bettor won over P26.9 richer in the November 19, 2026 draw, the Philippine Charity Sweepstakes Office (PCSO) announced on Thursday evening.

blocks.text: A Lotto 6/42 bettor won over P26.9 richer in the November 19, 2026 draw, the Philippine Charity Sweepstakes Office (PCSO) announced on Thursday evening.
The winning Lotto 6/42 numbers of 15-40-08-34-23-10 unlocked a jackpot prize totaling P26,912,539.06.
Meanwhile, there was no winner for Superlotto 6/49 and its P120,557,444.82 prize. The correct combination was 23-24-10-02-09-37.
